sections.title: Other Events.
sections.text:
On November 3, 2026, The Procter & Gamble Company (the “Company”) closed an underwritten public
offering of €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 3.750% Notes due November 3, 2030, €1,000,000,000
aggregate principal amount of 4.100% Notes due November 3, 2034, €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of
4.250% Notes due November 3, 2038 and €750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.625% Notes due
November 3, 2046 under the Company’s Registration Statement on Form S-3 (Registration No. 333-299472). Legal
opinions related to these notes are attached hereto as Exhibits (5)(a) and (5)(b) and are incorporated herein by
reference.
